title: Email-campaign workflow — assembly
note: The workflow CONSTRUCTED from the card inventory (the developer's reframing, 2026-08-19: the SE deck is a comprehensive task list from various inputs, not yet the workflow to design around). Each save appends one full snapshot of a reviewer's assembled flow: ordered card entries with now/later development scope, reviewer-drafted additions (DN-*) embedded whole, and the archived list. Latest snapshot per reviewer wins; convergence across reviewers is a human discussion, never a merge. The accepted assembly becomes the development baseline that feeds a pipeline view.
